report.summary: tests/test_canary_livewire.py: Tests for the canary live-wire gate that prevents real vendor calls unless --live flag is set, using process spawn sentinels and socket blocking.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_canary_livewire.py|The file claims that by driving the gate via spawn sentinel, tests go red if the gate is deleted.
todos: tests/test_canary_livewire.py|fixture|spawn_sentinel|Records every attempt to start a vendor process and blocks it.
tests/test_canary_livewire.py|fixture|no_socket|Blocks any TCP connection attempt.
tests/test_canary_livewire.py|fixture|no_run|Makes any attempt to build or run the canary an outright failure.
